experiments.title: Curuai open-water model
experiments.scope: Exposed water at one Curuai site, using NISAR L-band data at 60 m and Sentinel-2 optical water references.

metrics.label: August spatial holdout, HH threshold overlap
October temporal holdout, HH threshold overlap
October temporal holdout, dual-pol logistic overlap
August to October water-loss overlap, HH threshold
August to October water-loss overlap, dual-pol logistic

notes: Both models were fitted to August training blocks, then frozen before October scoring. The October comparisons use spatial blocks withheld from fitting.

Transfer to the later date was weaker than within-date agreement. The experiment evaluates exposed water and change against an optical proxy. Drought attribution requires a seasonal baseline and independent hydrological evidence.

experiments.title: Oman and UAE slick candidate screening
experiments.scope: NISAR L-band HH screening fitted on Oman and checked with a fixed threshold against a separate UAE reference case at 60 m.

metrics.label: Oman overlap among eligible mapped cells
UAE overlap among 2,075 eligible mapped cells

notes: The reference maps represent candidate slick evidence from other sensors, acquired at different times. Unlabelled water may contain either class, so precision and false-positive rates are unestimated.
This holdout provides no positive evidence that the fitted threshold transfers to another incident.
